correctness.rationale: For K_h join (K_a disjoint_union K_b), h>=2,a,b>=1, distances differ from the complete graph only by A-to-B value 2. On zero-sum coefficients the powered quadratic form is -sum z_i²+2(2^p-1)αβ. Group-mean decomposition gives negative within-group deviations plus the explicit 2x2 matrix R with diagonals 1/a+1/h and 1/b+1/h and off diagonal 1/h-(2^p-1). Its PSD condition yields the stated log2(1+1/h+sqrt((1/h+1/a)(1/h+1/b))) endpoint and 1D nullity, with dimensions N-1 below and N-2 at critical exponent. At p=1 determinant rearranges to (h-2)ab<=h+a+b. Since F=(h-2)ab-(h+a+b) grows under nontrivial exclusive-size enlargement, enumerating boundary N=8 yields no failures, N=9 exactly triples (4,2,3) and (5,2,2) up to exchange. Independent exhaustive tuple enumeration through N=9 reproduced both and direct PSD witness signs. Scope is ONLY this chordal family, not all chordal graphs.
